fragments.derivationNote: Pinned OHM version-38 generalized reconstruction accepted only for the post-Adrianople 1713–1720 interval after primary-document corroboration and broad west-to-Pacific controls. It is not used for 1699–1710 despite the source tag.

historicalDate.original: 13 июня 1713 г. / 24 июня 1713 г. — Адрианопольское урегулирование

baseStates.notes: Starts only in the exact month of the 1713 follow-up settlement, after the post-Pruth southern state is fixed. The same external legal contour is retained through August 1721 solely to provide continuous replay up to the Nystad ratification exchange; Russian Empire coverage for January–August 1721 reuses the same verified geometry in a separate base state. No geometry is carried across the September 1721 Nystad change.
